decisions.reason: The quantified savings of over €600,000 per year signal success, and escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping this publicly promoted product.
Its dedicated website page signals high visible commitment and a central product, making management unlikely to drop it despite the lack of quantified results.
Although only briefly mentioned, the firm has already invested in this concept and tends to justify prior commitments, so escalation pressure keeps it on the market.
As a newly launched product with sunk costs and public mention, escalation of commitment leads management to keep it while allowing more time for evaluation.
